description: The point readings of the legacy parsePointQuery, taken before it was deleted, and what recognize reads where the two differ. Each case is a trimmed text and the reading readPoint returns, or null.

draw.source: the inputs of packages/mailwoman/tools/dev-tools/recognize/point-differential.run.ts: the string literals of the three spatial test files and seeded generated inputs
draw.note: agreed rows: both readers return the same value, spread evenly over the sorted inputs of each kind. legacy_only rows: parsePointQuery returned a point and the specification refuses the text. recognize_only rows: parsePointQuery returned null and the specification reads a point.
